description: Vélo en libre-service de la ville d'Amiens is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Amiens Métropole - Communauté d'Agglomération. The data are available in GBFS format and make it possible to know: List of stations (geolocation, name, address, identifier) Status of stations (number of bikes available and free spaces) The flow comes from JCDecaux. Coverage: Amiens Métropole - Communauté d'Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Self-service bike of the city of Amiens" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Amiens Métropole - Communauté d'Agglomération. Its keywords include amiens-commune. The listing shows 5 download or service links in GBFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
